info.name: Refinitiv Data Platform (RDP) Historical Pricing API
info.description:
Cloud-enabled RESTful API providing access to streaming and non-streaming financial data, news, research, and analytics. It serves as the primary programmatic interface to the breadth of Refinitiv content on the LSEG Data Platform, including historical pricing, ESG data, news, quantitative analytics, symbology, and search services.

Contact Support:
 Name: LSEG Developer Support
